coordinate_basis: Architect grid T04 intersect T-C; U toward T07, V toward T-A; metres. RL is absolute, ground RL3.70.
attribution: Original Low Poly Earth mesh derived from WilkinsonEyre / Bates Smart architectural plans, NSW Planning Portal SSD-6957-MOD-1; geographic registration © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

registration.method: Fixed architect north-arrow rotation, translation-only symmetric uniformly arc-length sampled perimeter registration; soft-L1 distance loss with 2m scale. Five starts, 768 samples in each direction. No scale or warp.

source_roof_curves.coordinate_system: u toward T07, v toward T-A; origin T04/T-C; RL absolute metres.

vertices.reason: No visible south curve at this height; do not invent hidden correspondence.

source_roof_curves.method: Exact piecewise straight vector crown polylines from West/South elevations. South offset fitted to both L71 extreme silhouette intersections; half-span mismatch0.699pt=0.074m. Stereo candidates pair equal absolute heights and choose nearest L71 plan perimeter, only for visible curves. These are candidates, not independently verified hidden roof points.
source_roof_curves.limitations: The rim leans inward above L71, and many south curves overlap/occlude. Keep source curves for final orthographic validation. South high rim is calibrated to its explicit275m roof annotation; general left floor-datum dashed line is1.44pt lower than high-rim top. No assumed flat roof or uniform petal height.
source_roof_curves.stereo_candidates_use: Diagnostic correspondence candidates only. Main/rear point lists jump between overlapping branches and MUST NOT be lofted as ordered rim polygons. Front lower rim has strong plan agreement; interpolate the one missing point from its West curve.

roof.method: Plan leaf correspondence checked against West and South elevation curves; bounded continuation above L71.

modelling_limits: Floor silhouettes follow registered architect sections; intermediate sections are interpolated.
Apartment terrace recesses and facade microdetails are simplified for game scale.
Hotel oversail follows the labelled104.6m outer tip with a rounded rise from the tower junction; not an as-built BIM model.
